scope.evidence_basis: Actual original-source comparison and local derivation reread: Read Theorem 1 and the right-mean/time-reversal proof on pp. 71--73. Every interior interval integral is controlled; translation is in the same E norm and target exponent. Only sufficiency is asserted. At infinity the conclusion supplies continuous representatives; compactness of arbitrary L-infinity singletons is not characterized.
